n-k-k3-01.title: Weekend at home?
n-k-k3-01.goal: Compare classmate strong claim with short diary, choose frequency word wey evidence support, and explain why ‘always’ too much.
n-k-k3-01.material:
Classmate talk: ‘세진은 주말에 항상 집에 있어요.’ You read 세진 weekend diary for 4 weeks:

1주 토요일: 집에서 쉬었어요.
1주 일요일: 집에서 책을 읽었어요.
2주 토요일: 친구랑 극장에서 영화를 봤어요.
2주 일요일: 집에서 쉬었어요.
3주 토요일: 집에서 게임을 했어요.
3주 일요일: 집에서 청소를 했어요.
4주 토요일: 집에서 쉬었어요.
4주 일요일: 공원에서 자전거를 탔어요.
n-k-k3-01.prereq.1: Know 항상 (always) and 아니에요 (is not); other frequency words (보통, 가끔, 거의) explained in hints and explanation
n-k-k3-01.s.s1.prompt: Which sentence about 세진 get best support from whole diary?
n-k-k3-01.s.s1.hint.0: Count how many of 8 weekend days dem spend at home and how many outside.
n-k-k3-01.s.s1.hint.1: Match numbers with words: 항상 = every time, 보통 = most of the time, 가끔 = now and then, 거의 없어요 = hardly ever.
n-k-k3-01.s.s1.r.a: Two of 8 days happen outside (cinema and park), so ‘always’ go too far.
n-k-k3-01.s.s1.r.b: Six of 8 days at home, so ‘never at home’ na opposite of diary.
n-k-k3-01.s.s1.r.d: ‘가끔’ mean only now and then. Diary show home most days, more than ‘sometimes.’
n-k-k3-01.s.s1.r.e: ‘거의 없어요’ mean hardly ever at home, opposite of 6 out of 8 at home.
n-k-k3-01.s.s1.explain: Count days: 6 of 8 weekend days at home, 2 not. ‘Most of the time’ (보통) fit; ‘every time’ (항상) too strong, and ‘sometimes’ or ‘hardly ever’ too weak.
n-k-k3-01.s.s2.prompt: Your classmate say ‘세진은 주말에 항상 집에 있어요.’ Which diary entries show claim false? Choose all wey apply.
n-k-k3-01.s.s2.hint.0: Claim talk about EVERY weekend day. Which kind of day go break am: one wey fit or no fit?
n-k-k3-01.s.s2.hint.1: For each entry, decide: e fit claim or break am?
n-k-k3-01.s.s2.r.a: This day happen at home, so e agree with claim. E no show claim wrong.
n-k-k3-01.s.s2.r.c: This day at home too, so e agree with claim.
n-k-k3-01.s.s2.explain: One day wey no fit break ‘always.’ Days at home only agree with claim; dem no prove am because claim about every day.
n-k-k3-01.s.s2.acc.0: One counterexample already enough to break ‘항상’; second one, 4주 일요일, show say e no happen just once.
n-k-k3-01.s.s3.prompt: Answer classmate in polite Korean (-요). Say ‘항상’ no correct, and give one day from diary as proof.
n-k-k3-01.s.s3.hint.0: Start by saying ‘not always,’ then add one diary entry.
n-k-k3-01.s.s3.hint.1: Say where 세진 dey that day, using -에서.
n-k-k3-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: I name one specific day or place from diary?
n-k-k3-01.s.s3.selfAssess.2: My answer friendly and not harsh?
n-k-k3-01.s.s3.modelNote.1: E name better word and give proof.

n-k-k3-02.title: 하나 plan and library notice
n-k-k3-02.topic: Time and place clash between plan and notice
n-k-k3-02.goal: Check friend weekly plan against notice, find one conflicting line, say what kind of clash, and fix plan.
n-k-k3-02.material:
하나 send you plan for this week. School library put up notice:

[학교 도서관 안내]
- 문을 열어요: 화요일~일요일, 오전 9시~오후 6시
- 월요일은 쉬어요.
- 책은 2주 동안 빌릴 수 있어요.
n-k-k3-02.thinking.2: Fix plan without changing its goal
n-k-k3-02.prereq.1: Know weekdays and 오전/오후 + number + 시
n-k-k3-02.s.s1.prompt: 하나 plan for this week no fit notice in one line. Choose that line.
n-k-k3-02.s.s1.hint.0: First list days and hours library open, using only notice.
n-k-k3-02.s.s1.hint.1: Check every line about library: do day AND hour fit your list?
n-k-k3-02.s.s1.explain: Line 2 say library on Monday, but notice say library close Mondays. Line 5 (Sunday, 5 p.m.) okay because library open Sunday until 6 p.m.
n-k-k3-02.s.s2.prompt: Wetin exactly wrong with that line?
n-k-k3-02.s.s2.hint.0: Compare day in line with notice, then compare time.
n-k-k3-02.s.s2.hint.1: Say which one (day or time), if any, no fit notice.
n-k-k3-02.s.s2.o.a: 하나 plan to go before library open.
n-k-k3-02.s.s2.r.a: Opening time 9 a.m., so 10 a.m. dey within hours; problem na another detail.
n-k-k3-02.s.s2.o.b: 하나 plan to go on day wey clash with another line.
n-k-k3-02.s.s2.r.b: No other line of her plan dey on that day, so this no be problem.
n-k-k3-02.s.s2.o.c: 하나 plan to go after library close.
n-k-k3-02.s.s2.r.c: Time (10 a.m.) dey within opening hours; problem na another detail.
n-k-k3-02.s.s2.o.d: 하나 plan to go on day library close.
n-k-k3-02.s.s2.explain: Time okay, but closed day mean visit no possible. To check plan against notice, check every detail (day, time, place); one mismatch enough.
n-k-k3-02.s.s3.prompt: Rewrite wrong line in polite Korean so plan work. Keep goal (borrow books), but change day or time.
n-k-k3-02.s.s3.hint.0: Choose day notice say library open, then choose time between opening and closing.
n-k-k3-02.s.s3.hint.1: Keep pattern day + time: place + object + verb, like other lines.
n-k-k3-02.s.s3.selfAssess.0: New day na day library open?
n-k-k3-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: My new time fit opening hours (9 a.m. to 6 p.m.)?
n-k-k3-02.s.s3.selfAssess.2: New day clash with another line in 하나 plan?

n-k-k3-03.s.s2.ok.c0: Use whole dates and whole hours.
n-k-k3-03.title: Movie date with limits
n-k-k3-03.goal: Turn friend text with different limits (days unavailable, earliest time, fixed ending) into valid plans, find more than one and report one in Korean.
n-k-k3-03.material:
지호 text you:

‘이번 주 평일에 같이 영화를 봐요! 월요일이랑 수요일에는 학원이 있어서 안 돼요. 다른 날은 오후 3시 이후에 시간이 있어요. 영화는 두 시간이에요. 오후 6시까지는 끝나야 해요.’
n-k-k3-03.thinking.0: Hidden condition: movie length changes start time
n-k-k3-03.prereq.1: Know weekdays and 오후 + number + 시
n-k-k3-03.prereq.2: You don see -까지 (by/until), 이후 (after), 전에 (before); hints explain dem
n-k-k3-03.s.s1.prompt: Movie take 2 hours and must finish by 6 p.m. Wetin be LATEST start time wey work?
n-k-k3-03.s.s1.hint.0: Take 6 o’clock and subtract movie length.
n-k-k3-03.s.s1.hint.1: Check answer by adding 2 hours. Result na 6 or earlier?
n-k-k3-03.s.s1.r.b: That na time movie must finish, no be time e fit start.
n-k-k3-03.s.s1.r.c: If e start 5 p.m., e go finish 7 p.m., after 6.
n-k-k3-03.s.s1.r.d: 3 p.m. fit, but na earliest start friend allow, no be latest.
n-k-k3-03.s.s1.explain: Start + 2 hours must be 6 or earlier, so latest start na 4. Along with ‘after 3 p.m.’ only 3 and 4 fit.
n-k-k3-03.s.s2.prompt: Find 3 plans wey meet every condition in 지호 text, each on different day or time. d = day number (월=1, 화=2, 수=3, 목=4, 금=5); h = movie start hour in afternoon (3 mean 3 p.m.).
n-k-k3-03.s.s2.hint.0: 이후 mean after (count from) that time; -까지 mean until/by that time.
n-k-k3-03.s.s2.hint.1: Rewrite message as rules in your own words: which days unavailable, from what time, and by when movie must finish.
n-k-k3-03.s.s2.hint.2: Do days first: cross out 월 and 수. Then try each start time and add 2.
n-k-k3-03.s.s2.hint.3: If one plan rejected, read message under table; e say which rule fail.
n-k-k3-03.s.s2.var.h: movie start hour in afternoon (3 = 3 p.m.)
n-k-k3-03.s.s2.fail.c0: Use whole day number and whole hour.
n-k-k3-03.s.s2.fail.c1: 지호 want weekday, so d na 1 to 5.
n-k-k3-03.s.s2.fail.c2: 지호 get 학원 on Monday (1) and Wednesday (3). 월요일 수요일
n-k-k3-03.s.s2.fail.c4: 2-hour movie wey start that late go finish after 6 p.m.
n-k-k3-03.s.s2.explain: Days fit be Tuesday, Thursday, or Friday, and start time fit be 3 or 4 p.m., so 6 plans dey. Message give limits, no be one fixed appointment. 화 목 금
n-k-k3-03.s.s2.because.prompt: Choose ONE plan and send 지호 short polite Korean text (-요) with day, start time and movie.
n-k-k3-03.s.s2.because.hint.0: Use one plan above: which day and hour?
n-k-k3-03.s.s2.because.hint.1: Say day first, then time, then movie, and end with -요.
n-k-k3-03.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: My day and time match one plan I made?
n-k-k3-03.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: If 지호 say yes, e go follow his rules?

n-k-k3-04.s.s1.hint.0: Decide using only wetin you don read so far.
n-k-k3-04.title: Is 민수 coming to picnic?
n-k-k3-04.topic: Certainty and source of a message
n-k-k3-04.goal: Update your guess about whether classmate go come as new messages arrive, notice guess words, and report news with right certainty.
n-k-k3-04.material: You dey collect names for class picnic on Saturday and need know how much food buy. You wonder if 민수 go come. Messages go arrive one after another.
n-k-k3-04.thinking.1: Who talk am (friend guess or the person himself)
n-k-k3-04.thinking.2: Change conclusion when new information arrive
n-k-k3-04.prereq.1: Know 아마 (probably) and -ㄹ 것 같아요 (it seems); hints explain dem.
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.prompt: Read each message in order, choose the most likely meaning, then continue.
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.hint.1: Notice who dey speak in each message and words wey soften sentence (아마, -ㄹ 것 같아요).
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.0.ask: How sure 지아 be say 민수 go come Saturday?
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.0.after: 아마 show say na guess. For now, “probably coming” reasonable, no be “surely coming.”
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.0.o.a: She completely sure say e go come.
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.0.r.a: 아마 mean “probably.” Person wey completely sure no need use am.
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.0.o.b: She don decide say e no go come.
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Nothing for sentence say e no go come; 올 거예요 point to coming.
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.0.o.c: She think say e probably go come, but she no certain.
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.0.o.d: She no know who 민수 be.
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.0.r.d: She dey talk about am as someone she know; sentence concern whether e go come.
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.1.ask: Now 민수 himself dey talk. How things look?
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.1.after: -ㄹ 것 같아요 and 아직 몰라요 show say matter still open. Wetin person himself talk count pass friend guess.
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Matter never settle: e fit get hospital appointment, so e fit no manage come.
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.1.o.b: He probably go come because 지아 talk so.
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Now the person himself say e no sure, so 지아 guess no strong.
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.1.o.c: He probably don go hospital already.
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.1.r.c: 갈 것 같아요 talk about future possible visit, no be something wey don happen.
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.1.o.d: He probably don decide say e no go come.
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.1.r.d: 아직 몰라요 mean e never decide, so you no fit say e no go come.
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.2.ask: Wetin you fit say now as you plan picnic?
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.2.after: New message replace old guess: e clear say e dey come, but “small late” still be guess (-ㄹ 것 같아요).
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.2.o.a: 민수 probably no fit come because of hospital.
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Hospital visit don happen already (다녀왔어요), and e say e fit come.
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.2.o.b: 민수 go probably come on time.
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.2.r.b: E say e go small late, so no plan say e go reach on time.
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Still impossible to know if e dey come.
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Now e clearly say e fit go Saturday; yesterday question don get answer.
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.2.o.d: 민수 fit come Saturday, probably small late.
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.reflect: Your idea about 민수 change with each message. Friend guess (아마) get replaced by his own unsure words, then by his clearer words. Words like 아마 and -ㄹ 것 같아요 show guesses, and newest message from person himself na best source.
n-k-k3-04.s.s2.prompt: Which phrases from the three messages show speaker no completely sure? Choose all.
n-k-k3-04.s.s2.hint.0: For each phrase ask: speaker reporting something wey happen, or guessing wetin fit happen?
n-k-k3-04.s.s2.hint.1: Try replace phrase with “for sure.” Sentence still make sense?
n-k-k3-04.s.s2.r.b: This na plain statement of something wey don happen, so na fact, no be guess.
n-k-k3-04.s.s2.explain: 아마 mean probably, -ㄹ 것 같아요 mean “e seem say,” and 아직 몰라요 mean “I no know yet.” Past statement like 다녀왔어요 report fact.
n-k-k3-04.s.s3.prompt: Write news for picnic group chat in Korean (polite): say 민수 dey come and mark one thing wey still be guess.
n-k-k3-04.s.s3.hint.0: Write two short sentences: one for wetin clear, one for wetin no clear.
n-k-k3-04.s.s3.hint.1: For unclear part, use word or ending wey you see inside messages.
n-k-k3-04.s.s3.selfAssess.0: I clearly say say e dey come?
n-k-k3-04.s.s3.selfAssess.1: I keep “small late” as guess, no be fact?
n-k-k3-04.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Group go know how many people to count?
n-k-k3-04.s.s3.modelNote.1: Use 아마 and 쯤 for guess.

n-k-k3-05.title: Who 하준 mean by “저도요”?
n-k-k3-05.topic: Who talk wetin: answer wey depend on line before
n-k-k3-05.goal: Work out who and wetin short “me too” refer to inside group chat, decide facts wey still missing for group decision, and ask for one of dem.
n-k-k3-05.material:
Three friends are choosing lunch in a group chat. The restaurant's 비빔밥 usually comes with spicy red-pepper sauce (고추장).

지아: 저는 비빔밥을 먹을래요.
하준: 저도 비빔밥이 좋아요.
서윤: 저는 매운 음식을 못 먹어요.
하준: 저도요.
n-k-k3-05.thinking.0: Who talk wetin and wetin answer refer to
n-k-k3-05.prereq.2: Know 맵다 (spicy) in form 매운 / 안 매워요
n-k-k3-05.s.s1.prompt: Read chat. For last line, wetin 하준 mean by “저도요”?
n-k-k3-05.s.s1.hint.0: Find the line just above “저도요.” E dey answer that.
n-k-k3-05.s.s1.hint.1: Ask: “also” same as who, and about wetin?
n-k-k3-05.s.s1.o.a: He also wan eat 비빔밥, like 지아.
n-k-k3-05.s.s1.r.a: “저도요” answer the line right before am. Na 서윤 line, no be 지아.
n-k-k3-05.s.s1.o.b: He also wan eat lunch with 서윤.
n-k-k3-05.s.s1.r.b: Line before talk food, no be eating together.
n-k-k3-05.s.s1.o.c: He also think 비빔밥 too spicy.
n-k-k3-05.s.s1.r.c: 서윤 only say she no fit eat spicy food. 하준 dey answer that line, and he no mention 비빔밥 there.
n-k-k3-05.s.s1.o.d: He also no fit eat spicy food, like 서윤.
n-k-k3-05.s.s1.explain: -도 (“also”) join wetin person say now to wetin just said. Line before 하준 na 서윤: she no fit eat spicy food. So 하준 no fit too. Two lines earlier he say e like 비빔밥, so he must think say 비빔밥 fit be mild.
n-k-k3-05.s.s2.prompt: Can all three friends eat 비빔밥 together? Choose ALL things wey you still need know before answering.
n-k-k3-05.s.s2.hint.0: List wetin each person don say, mark wetin still missing for each one.
n-k-k3-05.s.s2.hint.1: Cross out facts wey no go change answer, no matter wetin dem be.
n-k-k3-05.s.s2.o.a: Whether restaurant fit make 비빔밥 wey no spicy.
n-k-k3-05.s.s2.o.b: Whether 하준 really no fit eat spicy food.
n-k-k3-05.s.s2.r.b: He just talk so with 저도요, so you already know.
n-k-k3-05.s.s2.r.c: Wetin 지아 eat yesterday no decide wetin the three fit eat today.
n-k-k3-05.s.s2.o.d: Whether 서윤 ready to eat 비빔밥 if e no spicy.
n-k-k3-05.s.s2.r.e: 지아 wan 비빔밥 either way; whether she like spice no stop others from eating am.
n-k-k3-05.s.s2.explain: Two things still open. Food must be available without spice, and 서윤 only say wetin she cannot eat, no be wetin she want. Other facts no change the answer.
n-k-k3-05.s.s3.prompt: Write polite Korean question for group chat to get one missing fact. No decide for dem.
n-k-k3-05.s.s3.hint.0: Choose one missing fact you find.
n-k-k3-05.s.s3.hint.1: Turn am into question with -요? or -ㄹ까요?
n-k-k3-05.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Answer go give one of the two missing facts?
n-k-k3-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: My question polite and easy to answer with one short sentence?
n-k-k3-05.s.s3.modelNote.1: Ask for the other missing fact.
